title: Red Hat Security Advisory: nginx security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in the nginx web and proxy server as part of a Red Hat security advisory. These include arbitrary code execution, denial of service, heap-based buffer overflow, heap buffer over-read, and memory disclosure issues affecting various nginx modules such as ngx_http_rewrite_module, HTTP/2 header processing, and ngx_http_slice_module. The advisory pertains to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support and related variants. The update addresses critical security flaws that could allow attackers to execute code or disrupt service.
